name: LPSG media rendering scalability — overlay 2 of 6
description: Makes LPSG media cards load predictably at scale with a persistent observer, eager above-the-fold loading, visible skeleton/error/retry states, stable aspect ratios, content visibility, and chunked rendering.
notes: Requires overlay 1 v2 as its exact source state.
Persistent IntersectionObserver is reused instead of being disconnected/recreated for every render chunk.
The first mobile/desktop media window is loaded eagerly; remaining images are observed ahead of the viewport.
Unknown image dimensions use a stable 4:3 provisional ratio instead of a 200px blank minimum and converge to natural dimensions after load.
Image/video thumbnail failures show an explicit state with manual Retry thumbnail action; automatic image retries remain preserved.
content-visibility and contain-intrinsic-size reduce off-screen rendering work while existing requestAnimationFrame chunking bounds insertion work.
Audit pass 1 added equivalent video-poster loading/error handling and natural image aspect-ratio convergence.
Audit pass 2 found and fixed an invisible-skeleton/1x1-placeholder race that could mark thumbnails loaded before the real request.
Audit pass 3 found no remaining promised-scope gaps; node --check and static contract assertions passed.
